info.title: API.SH: SourceForge
info.description: The SourceForge API from API.SH: public SourceForge data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: before

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Download statistics of a project or one of its folders over a date range: total, downloads per day, per country, per operating system and per operating system in each country, with the top country and OS.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sourceforge-download-stats

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Project name (as in sourceforge.net/projects/<name>/) or a project link.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 29 days before end_date).

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Only downloads of files in this folder, e.g. 7-Zip.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One SourceForge project: name, summary, description, status, creation date, homepage, categories (license, OS, programming language, audience, topic, development status, user interface, translations), developers, tools (files, code, tickets, wiki, forums), screenshots, average rating and review count, downloads this week, last update, and the latest release file overall and for each platform (Windows, Mac, Linux) with size, date and checksums.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sourceforge-project

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Project name (as in sourceforge.net/projects/<name>/) or a project link.

get.description:
User reviews of a project, newest first, with star rating, text, date, reviewer's username and helpful votes, plus the average rating, the count for each star and the ease / features / design / support ratings. Filter by stars. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sourceforge-reviews

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Project name (as in sourceforge.net/projects/<name>/) or a project link.

parameters.name: stars
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars (1-5).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Tickets of a project's tracker (bugs, feature requests, support requests, patches), newest first, with number, summary and link, and the tracker's milestones; `q` searches the tracker (e.g. status:open). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sourceforge-tickets

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Project name (as in sourceforge.net/projects/<name>/) or a project link.

parameters.name: tracker
parameters.description: Tracker name as in the project's menu (default bugs), e.g. feature-requests, support-requests, patches.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search the tracker, e.g. status:open or crash.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
